extracted.intended_audience: Investigators preparing NIH PHS 398 grant applications (PD/PIs, senior/key personnel, institutional research administrators)
extracted.subtask_description: Preparing and assembling an NIH PHS 398 grant application package, including biographical sketches, budget (modular), specific aims, research strategy, human/animal/select-agent sections, and required attachments.

rubrics_metrics.name: Biographical Sketch — required format and content
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide the following information for the Senior/key personnel and other significant contributors in the order listed on Form Page 2. Follow this format for each person. DO NOT EXCEED FOUR PAGES.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include NAME; POSITION TITLE; eRA COMMONS USER NAME (credential); a Personal Statement; Positions & Honors; Selected peer-reviewed publications; and other sections as shown. Present information for each listed person in the order on Form Page 2 and keep the entire biographical sketch to four pages or less.

rubrics_metrics.name: Education/Training table
rubrics_metrics.description: EDUCATION/TRAINING (Begin with baccalaureate or other initial professional education, such as nursing, include postdoctoral training and residency training if applicable.) INSTITUTION AND LOCATION DEGREE (if applicable) MM/YY FIELD OF STUDY
rubrics_metrics.guidance: List formal education/training chronologically beginning with the baccalaureate, including dates and field of study; include postdoctoral and residency training where applicable.

rubrics_metrics.name: Personal Statement (biosketch)
rubrics_metrics.description: A short narrative personal statement summarizing relevant experience and qualifications (example: summary of research focus, key accomplishments, and statement why well qualified to contribute to the proposed studies).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the Personal Statement to link the individual's expertise and prior accomplishments directly to the proposed work (example text in the form demonstrates concise justification of qualifications and relevant contributions).

rubrics_metrics.name: Positions, Employment, Other Experience and Honors
rubrics_metrics.description: A chronological listing of positions and employment, other experience, professional memberships, review panel service, and honors.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include dates and titles (e.g., Postdoctoral Fellow 1983-1984, Assistant Professor 1989-1992) and list honors and professional service to demonstrate qualifications and standing in the field.

rubrics_metrics.name: Selected Peer-reviewed Publications
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide selected peer-reviewed publications in chronological order (the example shows 'Selected peer-reviewed publications (in chronological order from X total)').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: List representative publications relevant to the proposed research; include citation details and identifiers (PMID/PMCID) where relevant. Choose publications that demonstrate expertise and prior contributions.

rubrics_metrics.name: PHS 398 — Research Plan attachments (required sections)
rubrics_metrics.description: Research Plan Attachments: 1. Introduction to Application (for RESUBMISSION or REVISION only); 2. Specific Aims; 3. *Research Strategy; 4. Inclusion Enrollment Report; 5. Progress Report Publication List; Human Subjects Sections (6. Protection of Human Subjects; 7. Inclusion of Women and Minorities; 8. Targeted/Planned Enrollment Table; 9. Inclusion of Children); Other Research Plan Sections (10. Vertebrate Animals; 11. Select Agent Research; 12. Multiple PD/PI Leadership Plan; 13. Consortium/Contractual Arrangements; 14. Letters of Support; 15. Resource Sharing Plan(s); 16. Appendix.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Attach each applicable section as a file attachment. Only include 'Introduction to Application' when resubmitting or revising. Ensure placement and order correspond with the PHS 398 form requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Specific Aims
rubrics_metrics.description: A concise statement of the overall goal(s) of the proposal and the enumerated Specific Aims (example shows three Specific Aims: Aim 1, Aim 2, Aim 3).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Clearly state the overarching objective and list discrete Specific Aims that will address the key questions. Specific Aims should be succinct and aligned with the Research Strategy and Significance sections.

rubrics_metrics.name: Research Strategy structure
rubrics_metrics.description: Research Strategy must include (a) Significance, (b) Innovation, and (c) Approach.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Significance: explain importance and public health relevance; Innovation: explain novel aspects and why the work is distinct; Approach: describe preliminary data, experimental design, methods, and how aims will be achieved. Provide preliminary studies where relevant and justify feasibility.

rubrics_metrics.name: Human Subjects — clinical trial designation and protection
rubrics_metrics.description: Human Subjects: Clinical Trial? (No / Yes). Agency-Defined Phase III Clinical Trial? (No / Yes). Protection of Human Subjects, Inclusion of Women and Minorities, Targeted/Planned Enrollment Table, Inclusion of Children are required Human Subjects sections.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Indicate whether the proposed project involves human subjects and whether it includes clinical trials (and the phase). Complete all required human subjects protections documentation and inclusion/enrollment reporting as applicable.

rubrics_metrics.name: Human Embryonic Stem Cells (HESC) disclosure
rubrics_metrics.description: Does the proposed project involve human embryonic stem cells? (No / Yes). If yes, list registration number(s) of the specific cell line(s) from the NIH registry or check a box that one from the registry will be used.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If hESCs are involved, provide the NIH registry numbers for the specific lines; if a line is not yet chosen, indicate that a registry-listed line will be used.

rubrics_metrics.name: Vertebrate Animals section
rubrics_metrics.description: Attachment required: Vertebrate Animals.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide the vertebrate animals description and justifications (procedures, species, numbers, pain/distress minimization) as an attachment when vertebrate animals are used.

rubrics_metrics.name: Select Agent Research disclosure
rubrics_metrics.description: Attachment required: Select Agent Research (Select Agent research.p).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If the proposed work involves select agents, provide the required select agent research documentation and safety/compliance information.

rubrics_metrics.name: Multiple PD/PI Leadership Plan
rubrics_metrics.description: If multiple PD/PIs are proposed, include a Multiple PD/PI Leadership Plan attachment.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describe roles, responsibilities, and leadership/communication plans among multiple PD/PIs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Consortium/Contractual Arrangements and Letters of Support
rubrics_metrics.description: Attach consortium/contractual arrangements and letters of support as applicable.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide documentation of subcontracts, collaborators, and letters that confirm commitments or resources relevant to the project.

rubrics_metrics.name: Resource Sharing Plan(s)
rubrics_metrics.description: Attachment required: Resource Sharing Plan(s).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include plans for sharing data, model organisms, software, or other resources generated by the award as appropriate.

rubrics_metrics.name: Modular Budget format and required budget fields
rubrics_metrics.description: PHS 398 Modular Budget: For each budget period include A. Direct Costs (Start Date, End Date, Funds Requested ($), Direct Cost less Consortium F&A, Consortium F&A, Total Direct Costs); B. Indirect Costs (Indirect Cost Type, Indirect Cost Rate (%), Indirect Cost Base ($), Funds Requested ($)); C. Total Direct and Indirect Costs (A + B).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide budget information separately for each project year/period. For modular budgets include the modular sections and totals; indicate start/end dates for each budget period.

rubrics_metrics.name: Indirect cost documentation
rubrics_metrics.description: Include Cognizant Agency (Agency Name, POC Name and Phone Number) and Indirect Cost Rate Agreement Date.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide the cognizant agency contact and the effective date of the institution's indirect cost rate agreement to support the requested indirect costs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Budget Justifications and attachments
rubrics_metrics.description: Budget Justifications: Personnel Justification, Consortium Justification, Additional Narrative Justification — attach supporting documents (e.g., 1245-DowBdgtJust.pdf).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Supply a Personnel Justification describing each named person's effort (calendar months) and specific duties; attach separate consortium justification and other narrative justifications as required.

rubrics_metrics.name: Personnel effort reporting and duties (in personnel justification)
rubrics_metrics.description: List personnel (name and role), calendar months effort (e.g., PI: 1.2 Calendar months), and specific duties (e.g., oversee project, experimental design, data analysis, manuscript preparation).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Quantify effort in calendar months (not percent effort) and provide clear descriptions of each person's responsibilities tied to the project.

rubrics_metrics.name: Application type and tracking (Research Plan header)
rubrics_metrics.description: Application Type: New / Resubmission / Renewal / Continuation / Revision (information from SF 424 (R&R) Cover Page is repeated here).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: State the application type and include the appropriate introductory materials (e.g., Introduction to Application only for resubmissions/revisions).

rubrics_metrics.name: Appendix — attachments and allowable items
rubrics_metrics.description: Appendix: Add Attachments / Remove Attachments / View Attachments (file attachments for allowed appendix materials).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include only permitted appendix materials per PHS 398 rules; manage attachments through the application interface and ensure compliance with page/formatting limits.

rubrics_metrics.name: PHS 398 Cover Page Supplement items
rubrics_metrics.description: Include Project Director / Principal Investigator name, Human Subjects clinical trial checkboxes, Applicant Organization Contact (name, title, street address, city, state, zip, phone, email, fax), and HESC questions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Complete the Cover Page Supplement with accurate PD/PI identification and organizational contact information; answer human subjects and HESC questions truthfully and completely.
